transcript:
This message comes from University at Buffalo, where scientists are working to protect the Great Lakes and fresh water supplies around the world from harmful contamination.
Learn more about their research at buffalo.edu/npr.
This is NPR News Now.
The latest headlines every hour.
Live from NPR News, I'm Dale Willman.
President Trump was in Kentucky Saturday visiting a state he won in 2024. He's hoping to give Republican candidates a boost just weeks before the midterms from member station WVXU and Cincinnati's Zach Carion reports.
Trump downplayed the impact of rising costs and again promised benefits if Republicans beat out Democrats this November.
If the Republicans win, you'll each have $5,000 in your pocket and economic success for our country like we have never seen before.
Trump told the crowd he expects candidates he's backed in Kentucky to win easily, but says other races will be close, like the Senate face-off between Ohio Republican incumbent John Husted and Democrat and former Senator Sherrod Brown.
For NPR News, I'm Zach Carion in Highland Heights, Kentucky.
In Lexington, Kentucky, Saturday's No Kings rally highlighted opposition to President Trump and aimed to energize voters ahead of the pivotal midterm elections.
Karen Zarr with member station WUKY reports from Lexington.
This is for our neighbors who are not inside.
Protesters held familiar signs against the Trump administration while organizers like Laura Hartke shared election information.
We've got four stations we want everyone to go to. The first one, early voting right over here.
Marion Madry with Kentuckians for the Commonwealth gathered signatures of anyone with felonies in their past needing to restore their voting rights.
It is very important that we protect our democracy.
The rally was billed as non-partisan despite the movement's opposition to Trump and congressional Republicans.
For NPR News, I'm Karen Zarr in Lexington.
Fire crews in Southern California are gaining ground on a wildfire that's burned at least six coastal homes there.
Officials say the Norte Fire is now about 25 percent contained, and that has allowed many of the evacuation orders to be lifted.
The fire is one of several in the region that have been driven by high Santa Ana winds.
Doctors have discharged Pope Leo the 14th from the hospital in Rome after just five days.
As Phil and Mark's reports, medical staff say the operation to remove a part of his lung that tested positive for cancer was successful.
Pope Leo left the Jamelli Hospital in central Rome waving to well-wishers outside as he walked out unaided, flanked by officials and security guards in dark suits.
The Vatican press office released a statement outlining details of the surgery from his own personal physician as well as the hospital's chief of thoracic surgery who led the team that operated on the pontiff.
Those two doctors say the Pope had undergone blood tests and a chest x-ray Saturday morning with the results confirming his clinical condition meant he could leave hospital.
The Vatican says Leo's post-operative recovery time had been faster than scheduled.
He's expected to lead the Angelus Prayer from the window of the papal apartment on Sunday.
For NPR News, I'm Willem Moggs.
And this is NPR News.
Higher fuel costs are putting pressure on the price of delivering groceries and holiday purchases, as NPR's Windsor Johnston reports some products are more exposed to higher prices than others.
Even if your car runs on unleaded gasoline, diesel prices will hit you squarely in the wallet.
Rutgers supply chain expert Rudolf Lucheiner says diesel powers the trucks delivering the goods to store shelves.
When you drive by a gas station, that's probably the number you should be looking at.
Refrigerated and frozen foods are under added pressure because deliveries can't wait.
And he says shoppers could pay more to get gifts delivered quickly.
We've already seen FedEx add some additional surcharges to overnight deliveries.
I wouldn't be surprised if during the holiday season we'll see a little bit more of that.
He also says consumers may have a hard time separating fuel charges from the usual holiday shipping fees.
Hurricane Trudy is strengthened to a Category 2 storm as it continues to move toward Mexico's southwestern and west-central Pacific coast.
Trudy is about 115 miles southwest of Manzanillo and moving northwest at 10 miles an hour.
It's sustained winds of 100 miles an hour.
Alex McPherson kicked a 34-yard field goal as time expired to lift unranked Auburn over No. 1 Georgia Saturday 27-24.
Jayden Boss scored a fourth-quarter touchdown as the Florida Gators rallied to beat the No. 7 Texas 27-24.
No. 8 BYU stopped No. 2 Notre Dame at the goal line to win 28-24 and incarnate wordbeat UT Rio Grande Valley, Vicaros 41-16.
I'm Dale Willman, NPR News.
